name: Hebrew
title: Levite in David's time
summary: Ibri was a Levite from the clan of Merari, son of Jaashah. He served in the temple service during King David's organization of the Levites. He is mentioned in 1 Chronicles as part of the Levitical service arrangement.

keyEvents.title: Mentioned among the descendants of Merari
keyEvents.description: Ibri is mentioned as the son of Jaashah among the descendants of Merari in connection with David's organization of the Levites' service.

keyEvents.title: David's organization of the Levites
keyEvents.description: King David organized the Levites into various divisions for service at the temple, and Ibri was assigned his place within this arrangement.

keyEvents.title: The Levitical Service Arrangement
keyEvents.description: As part of the clan of Merari, Ibri was included in the service arrangement that David established for worship in the temple.

keyEvents.title: The lineage of Merari
keyEvents.description: Ibri belonged to the branch of Levi's tribe known as Merari, which had specific duties related to the tabernacle and later the temple.
